response.text: Your goal is to migrate 6 Zaps from Zapier to your self-hosted n8n instance, including a form to Google Sheets, Sheets to Slack alerts, a Stripe payment to an email receipt, and three small Gmail filters, test them, and receive a short doc. My plan is: 1. Audit existing Zapier workflows and document triggers and actions for all 6 Zaps. 2. Rebuild the form to Google Sheets and Sheets to Slack alerts workflows in n8n. 3. Rebuild the Stripe payment email receipt workflow and the three Gmail filters in n8n. I did nearly this for a lead intake workflow: Lead entry dropped from about 2 hours a week to under 10 minutes. Can you provide access credentials or export JSONs of the existing 6 Zaps? Let's discuss the full plan.
